source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: The option-select submit handler awaits #initUI, then checks that #currentState still equals event.submitter.value before calling the current subview's setState with #accounts. That receiver is resolved dynamically from current state. Account selection consumes account wrappers; sync selection consumes found-book objects. If the state changes during the awaited initialization, the guard skips the stale accounts write. It does not serialize every transition, and the inspected normal-navigation tests do not directly assert this concurrent-change case. No UI race was reproduced.
title: Account Hub rechecks the active address-book step before sending account state
